title.narrative: Platform#5: Accelerating economic opportunities for women in Armenia

description.narrative: Platform#5: Accelerating economic opportunities for women in Armenia Project aims to have a wide-reaching impact in all regions of Armenia through collaborations with national and international partners, empowering vulnerable women economically and challenging gender stereotypes. The overall objective of the project is to empower vulnerable women, promote economic independence, and collaborate with national and international partners to ensure success. Expected outcomes include improved livelihoods, government adoption of new approaches, enhanced work-life balance, and changed attitudes among high-school students. Outputs and expected results of the project are 1) Strengthened agriculture value chains in target regions involving women; 2) Establishment and testing of innovative models to engage long-term unemployed women in non-traditional jobs; 3) Mid-career women in business and local self-governments leading pilot projects for family-friendly work environments, and 4) Execution of an awareness-raising camp
